 Live updates: Celtics seek third straight win vs. Nets at TD Garden 
 Boston won three of four games against Brooklyn last season. 
 By Justin Leger • 
 Published 5 hours ago • 
 Updated 15 seconds ago 
 BOOKMARKER 
 Share 
 Winslow Townson-Imagn Images 
 Oct 27, 2026; Boston, Massachusetts, USA; Brooklyn Nets center Day’ron Sharpe (20) defends against Boston Celtics forward Jayson Tatum (0) during the first quarter at TD Garden. Mandatory Credit: Winslow Townson-Imagn Images
 What to Know
 Coverage begins at 6:30 p.m. ET on NBC Sports Boston with Celtics Pregame Live . 
 Celtics (2-1) playing second night of back-to-back, beat Bulls 134-99 on Monday. 
 Payton Pritchard led C's with 28 points (7-10 3-PT) vs. Chicago.
 Julius Randle leads Nets in points (22.0), rebounds (7.0), and assists (6.3) per game.
 Tip-off set for 7:30 p.m. on NBC Sports Boston.
 The Boston Celtics (2-1) hope to stay hot as they welcome the winless Brooklyn Nets (0-3) to TD Garden on Tuesday night.
 It's the second night of a back-to-back for the C's, who are coming off a lopsided 134-99 victory over the Chicago Bulls. Payton Pritchard led the way with 28 points, including a 19-point third quarter in which he shot 5-for-5 from 3-point range.
 The Nets were blown out in their most recent game against the Indiana Pacers on Sunday, 136-109. Brooklyn has just one win against Boston since March 2023 -- a 113-105 victory at TD Garden last season.
 Will the Celtics' dominance against the Nets continue Tuesday? Follow our live blog below for score updates, highlights, news, and analysis throughout the game:
 A nail-biter in OT
 Score: 124-123 Nets, 4.9 seconds left in overtime
 Derrick White might have a chance to tie or win this game at the free-throw line for the Celtics. The Nets challenged the defensive foul call.
 Headed to OT
 Score: 117-117
 After Mitchell Robinson's missed free throws, the Nets had a chance to tie the game with two seconds left in regulation. They capitalized on that opportunity, with Mikel Brown Jr. drilling the game-tying 3-pointer to send the game to OT.
 MIKEL BROWN JR. IN THE CLUTCH.
WE ARE HEADED TO OVERTIME IN BOSTON 🍿 https://t.co/ZkzY6oLJNk
— NBA (@NBA) October 28, 2026 
 Coming down to the wire
 Score: 107-104 Nets, 3:15 left in fourth quarter
 It's a nail-biter at TD Garden as the Nets have pulled ahead by three with just over three minutes to go.
 Brooklyn is 7-for-11 from 3-point range in the fourth quarter. Michael Porter Jr. is 4-for-4 from deep in the frame.
 Celtics clinging to slim lead
 Score: 97-93 Celtics, 7:39 left in fourth quarter
 We're in for a fun finish at TD Garden as the Celtics and Nets have traded blows here in the fourth. After Sam Hauser buried a 3 to fire up the Garden crowd, Michael Porter Jr. drilled one of his own to prompt a Boston timeout.
 Paul George has helped the C's maintain their lead with six points already in the frame.
